basic_info.description: This updated 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath TIC flat is located in a well-maintained, turn-of-the-century 4 unit building in the heart of Lower Haight. With airy 11-foot ceilings, built-in cabinetry, 2 decorative fireplaces, and an updated kitchen, this home offers modern comfort, while maintaining classic details. The kitchen features sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a butler's pantry for additional storage. The 3 bedrooms each have closet space and one or more windows. The full bathroom & half bath provide convenience for everyday living, and the laundry room with closets is located just off the kitchen.  In addition to the living space, this home offers an exclusive-use storage room in the basement. The location is ideal, just one block from public transportation, shops, and restaurants, making it easy to enjoy all the neighborhood has to offer.  Monthly HOA dues are $405/mo, and cover water & sewer, trash, property insurance, management fees, and general maintenance. Prop. tax paid separately also through the HOA. Don't miss this excellent opportunity to live the quintessential SF experience!
